contract: What a lane must reach to be ENDED in this repository: every tip the lane delivered is contained in origin/main, origin carries only main, origin/main IS the verified integration baseline, and no delivery the lane produced is still unresolved. The deterministic answer is one command - skills/git-orchestrator/scripts/audit.mjs verify <repo> origin/main - which exits 0 only when all four hold; it runs at a landing's exit and at the next wave's entry (scripts/lib/lane-boundary.mjs, wired in scripts/wave-lifecycle.mjs). A lane that has not reached this is not ended: it is producing, blocked, or waiting for the merge lane, and it says which.

end_state.statement: origin carries only refs/heads/main at the verified baseline; every delivered tip is an ancestor of origin/main; the next wave re-verifies this baseline rather than trusting the previous receipt

gate.why: the full gate is a release's, not a landing's (2026-10-02): an evolution landing is merged, LF-checked and reported, and scripts/wave-release.mjs is what gates an exact tree and names it

deploy.when: a stage of its own, not a step of the release gate: after the wave's landings are merged and pushed, and whenever a wave changed what the install serves, what origin/main carries is installed without waiting for a release and without looking a release proof up. Queued through the sentinel from outside the run that produced the change - never from inside that run's own turn. The refusals that remain are about state: a dirty tree, a HEAD that is not on origin/main or is behind it, a downgrade of what is installed, a port held by another install, and an install directory the machine's service does not run its node from. WA_DEPLOY_REQUIRE_RELEASE_PROOF=1 (OFF by default - speed is the default path, and release and deploy are separate stages) is the only way to demand a release proof, and the deploy is then refused by name when the tree has none
deploy.evidence: installed.txt and deploy-result.json, read back rather than the request's receipt; installed.txt must name the exact commit with source_provenance=clean-built-by-deploy and record_role=final, and its sentinel_sha256 must be the sentinel that install carries - an interim record (record_role=interim, source_provenance=unverified-binary) is a deploy that did not finish its record step, never an install to trust

remote.push_guard: .githooks/pre-push refuses a push whose destination ref is not refs/heads/main while this file declares remote.main_only
